detail: 26 setup moves recognised with the stats each boosts. Setup is deliberately NOT in the support whitelist: a setup move is the centre of a build, not a filler slot, so it generates its own variant that is then measured against the non-setup build.
support track gated on an explicit whitelist of 72 status moves that change a fight. Growl and Tail Whip are status moves and are deliberately excluded.

the egg-move tutor teaches no fixed move list, so it is absent from the `tutors` array. The documentation places it in Fuchsia City, free after its challenge; Fuchsia's own tutor entry sits at gate 9, so egg moves are gated there. Gate is Asserted, the movepool itself is Measured.
move-pool gates from Phase 2: 118 TM moves, 57 tutor moves, 469 placed items. Egg-move tutor gate = 9.

232 (species-form, checkpoint) pairs qualified for NO track and are a finding, not a silent drop. Distinct forms affected: 100.
